name: @singularity/plugin-infra-deps-build
description: The build installer kind of infra/deps: build({ inputs, tool, output, run }) (its deps barrel) declares something built from this checkout's own source — identity = sha256 of every file the git ls-files input globs match, the tool's version output and the target platform/arch — built by run(ctx) straight into env/<output>, which is what isIntact checks; builtFile(ready) is its path. admission: { none } skips host admission for a build too small to be worth a grant.
